description: Baseline before any self-upgrade change: master @ 0652a78 (hostname fix, held-out leak fix, CI floor 0.91). CPU only; GPU present but unused (no torch/cupy installed).

Candidate: en_core_web_lg instead of en_core_web_sm as the spaCy detector (branch exp01-spacy-lg @ 4608805). REJECTED at the benchmark gate, so no case rescan: accepted-only P 0.9606->0.9589, single_token recall 0.9606->0.9310 (-3.0pp, over the 0.02 limit), F1 0.9362->0.9327, 2 tests fail (first-name propagation: lg's different span boundaries leave 'Kenji' of 'Dr. Kenji Ito' unaccepted). Only gain: benchmark_unseen recall 0.9655->1.000 (+1 of 29 mentions, noise). Timing +5% (1.80 vs 1.72 s; an earlier 9.8 s reading was machine-state noise, re-timed alternating with sm).

Candidate (branch exp02-bare-common-surname @ 27f0ced): an ACCEPTED single word that is an ordinary English word known only as a surname, with a dictionary hit as its only evidence and no accepted full name in the document starting/ending with it, moves to REVIEW. Gate: tests pass, dump005 0 FP, unseen P 1.000, no shape recall drop >0.02, speed flat. TRADE: benchmark accepted-only P 0.9606->0.9710 (+1.04pp), R 0.9131->0.9026 (-1.05pp, all one synthetic code-name alias), F1 flat; accepted+review unchanged. Real case: 8 names ACCEPTED->REVIEW (7 ordinary-word noise, 1 citation surname), nothing newly accepted or lost.

v1 (commit 18d5690): DictionaryDetector tokens must have no letter/digit/underscore before or after. Benchmark P 0.9710->0.9781, R unchanged. Real-case rescan vs exp02: 'Handler' 146 accepted -> 4 in review, 5 accepted names removed - 4 were fragments (Max from '..._Max', an app filename, a log tag, a surname glued to a domain while the full name stayed accepted) but 1 was a real cited author ('1Berger, A.'), lost because a digit before the name was blocked. Revised to v2.

v2 (commit 661dd0e): DictionaryDetector tokens need no letter/underscore before and no letter/digit/underscore after (a digit before is allowed: '1Berger, A.'). Benchmark vs exp02: accepted-only P 0.9710->0.9781, R unchanged, every shape unchanged, dump005 0 FP, unseen P 1.000, speed flat (1.71 s, 31 ms). Real case vs exp02: nothing newly accepted; 'Handler' 146 accepted -> 4 standalone mentions in review; 4 accepted fragments removed (an app filename, ..._Max, a log tag, a surname glued to a domain while the full name stays accepted); 45 REVIEW entries removed, 43 of them only ever glued inside longer tokens, 1 network label ('Aircel North'), 1 not found. Scan 939 s (after a restart; not claimed as a speed-up).

Short day/month names from es/pt/it/sv datepicker arrays added as calendar words (behavior changes only for dom, mie, mån, ott, tor); night, baby, beauty, fish, dip, era, mini, pan, karma, asin added to the first-name/common-word collision list. Benchmark identical to exp03 v2 (no such words in it). Real case vs exp03 v2: exactly 5 accepted names removed, all noise - Dom and Ott (datepicker arrays), Tor (the anonymity network in a VPN app menu), Night and Mie (tiny OCR fragments: 11-, 3- and 42-char files); nothing else changed.

Candidate (branch exp05-spacy-split-at-digits @ be13c62): SpacyDetector splits a PERSON entity at digit-bearing tokens as well as line breaks. Benchmark: overlap metrics identical to exp04; exact boundaries 1154 -> 1156 of 1205 accepted gold hits (both 'Farhan Vora', previously truncated to 'Farhan'); FP unchanged (27). Real case vs exp04: +1 accepted (a full name next to an ID number - previously swallowed the same way), +7 REVIEW entries, all noise (a journal abbreviation, a group name, a review fragment, an OCR scrap, a language name, a place name, a browser metric) that a digit-bearing spaCy span had been dragging into rejection. TRADE: 1 real accept recovered vs +2.3% REVIEW noise; accepted precision unaffected.

Candidate (branch exp06-middle-initial-names @ 7eba689, on top of exp04): a 'First I. Last' candidate with spaCy or single-token dictionary evidence passes CorroborationValidator even when the first name is on the collision list; _select_canonical_span widens a one-word dictionary hit to a middle-initial span ('Kurt' -> 'Kurt D. DelBene'). Benchmark identical (no such names in it). Real case vs exp04: 7 names newly ACCEPTED, all verified real people named in a public SEC 10-K (officer table and director signature block); nothing lost, REVIEW unchanged. Scan time 1,523 s taken under heavy machine load - not comparable; alternating on/off timing showed no cost.

Combined state on self-upgrade after promoting exp04, exp05 and exp06 (commit 9dcd37a): accuracy check that the changes don't interact. Timings taken while the machine was heavily loaded by other processes - not comparable.

Candidate (branch exp07-language-country-names @ 4c22eef): language names and country names in other languages (assets/languages/language_and_region_names.txt) get the calendar-word rule in CorroborationValidator - a bare single token needs a title or full first+last name, repetition doesn't count; excluded from span widening and first-name propagation. Words that are also real given names or surnames are kept off the list. Benchmark: accepted-only FP 27 -> 26 (a 'Telugu' in benchmark_001), P 0.9781 -> 0.9789, recall and every shape unchanged; unseen unchanged; dump005 0 FP. Real case vs the combined state: exactly 3 accepted names removed (Español, Telugu, Schweiz - language/region menus) and 2 REVIEW entries (España, Gujarati); nothing newly accepted, nothing real lost. Timings taken under heavy machine load; alternating on/off runs showed no cost (before 4.96-6.92 s, after 4.76-6.03 s).

Candidate (branch exp08-short-document-single-words @ a4a9b38): _cap_lone_single_tokens (structured data only until now) also holds a lone single word for REVIEW in a document under 30 Latin-letter words whose stopword share is below the existing 0.15 English-prose threshold (OCR scraps of images, lone words, terse records); a short genuine note is unaffected. Real case vs exp07: 13 accepted names -> REVIEW, all noise (words from garbled OCR scraps of images and image PDFs, lone words in one-word files, a locality fragment, an AI model name in a screenshot); nothing added or lost; benchmark identical. But fed line by line through the live path (Pipeline.run_text), benchmark_real_660 lost one real accept to REVIEW and gained nothing - live messages are short by nature. Revised to v2 (files only).

v2 (commit 65be9f9): _cap_lone_single_tokens (structured data only until now) also holds a lone single word for REVIEW in a FILE under 30 Latin-letter words whose stopword share is below the existing 0.15 English-prose threshold (OCR scraps of images, lone words, terse records); a short genuine note is unaffected, and live text (Pipeline.run_text, realtime sessions - no source format) keeps its previous decisions. Fed line by line through the live path, benchmark_real_660/675 are identical to exp07. Benchmark, shapes, unseen and dump005 identical to exp07. Real case vs exp07: 13 accepted names -> REVIEW, all noise (words from garbled OCR scraps of images and image PDFs, lone words in one-word files, a locality fragment, an AI model name in a screenshot); nothing added or lost; identical to the v1 scan. Speed back to normal (1.78 s, 32 ms, scan 970 s).

Candidate (branch exp09-llm-reviewer @ bc8eabd): optional local-LLM reviewer (Ollama, llama3.1:latest 46e0c10c039e, prompt v1, GPU): each file's ACCEPTED names with P(person) < 0.3 move to REVIEW (owner-confirmed names excepted); promotion built but off. Active only when Ollama runs the pinned model on a GPU (else skipped, reason in provenance); files only, never live text; --no-llm-review turns it off per run. Benchmark: accepted-only FP 26 -> 25, P 0.9789 -> 0.9797, recall and every shape unchanged; unseen unchanged; dump005 0 FP. Real case vs exp08b: exactly 14 accepted names -> REVIEW, all non-people (companies, a publisher, places, a building, interface style names, a phrase, a gun calibre, a code identifier, a Polish month, language-menu text, an OCR typo); nothing added or lost. TRADE: time - full scan 16.2 -> 40.0 min, benchmark pass 1.8 -> 67 s (the reviewer is 64 s of it; 0.37 s per name on the GPU, 3.07 s on the CPU only). Owner approved: on automatically on GPU machines.
